subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Bis(tri-tert-butylphosphine)palladium（Pd(Pt-Bu₃)₂）？
A. Linear
B. Trigonal planar
C. Octahedral
D. Trigonal prismatic
explanation: Linear. Covalent count: Pd (group 10) 10 e; 2 × P(t-Bu)₃ (L) 4 e: 14 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry no charge and the complex is neutral, so the metal is Pd(0), d¹⁰; d¹⁰ + 4 e from the ligands = 14 e. Bulky phosphines keep Pd(0) two-coordinate and very reactive.
